beats.label: S1 · The straw hat
beats.text: Young Luffy accidentally eats the Gum-Gum Fruit and becomes rubber. Shanks loses an arm saving him and leaves his straw hat, to be returned once Luffy is a great pirate.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Origin of Luffy's powers, the hat, and his lifelong debt to Shanks — all three drive everything he does.

beats.label: S1 · Out to sea
beats.text: Grown Luffy sets out, sinks the pirate Alvida with his rubber powers, and befriends her captive Coby, who wants to be a Marine as Luffy vows to become King of the Pirates.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Luffy's dream out loud and plants Coby, whose own arc into the Marines pays off later.

beats.label: S1 · Freeing Zoro
beats.text: At a Marine base, Luffy frees the swordsman Zoro from execution and recruits him. Coby enlists with the Marines, vowing to meet Luffy again on the opposite side.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First crewmate joins and Coby splits off to the other side of the badge — the two poles Luffy's world runs between.

beats.label: S1 · Meeting Nami
beats.text: Fleeing Buggy the Clown's crew with a stolen Grand Line map, thief Nami crosses paths with Luffy. She hates pirates but strings him along, still working her own angle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Nami and the Grand Line map — the crew's navigator and their destination, both in the same scene.

beats.label: S1 · Buggy revealed
beats.text: Buggy reveals he ate the Chop-Chop Fruit and can split his body to dodge blades. He was Shanks' fellow apprentice pirate and blames him for the accident that made him eat it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real Devil Fruit fight for the crew and the first hint that Shanks' past reaches into their present enemies.

beats.label: S1 · Bond over the hat
beats.text: Buggy damages Luffy's straw hat, enraging him. Nami steals Buggy's severed pieces so Luffy can send him flying, and the townspeople thank the pirates for saving them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nami acts as crew for the first time in a fight that only works because she chose to help; the hat becomes a fight trigger.

beats.label: S1 · Nami rides with them
beats.text: With Buggy defeated, Luffy, Zoro and Nami leave town aimed at the Grand Line. Nami rides with them for the map and the treasure, not because she has joined.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the exact shape of the crew heading into the Grand Line: a captain, a swordsman, and a navigator who has not committed.

cliffhanger.text: Luffy has a swordsman and a reluctant navigator and a stolen map to the Grand Line, but no way in and no ship built for it. Nami is riding with them for her own reasons, not because she has joined the crew.
questions: How will the crew actually cross into the Grand Line?
Will Nami stay on once she has what she came for?
When will Shanks come back for the hat?

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.line: Young pirate captain with a rubber body from the Gum-Gum Fruit, wearing Shanks' straw hat and aiming to be King of the Pirates.

characters.name: Roronoa Zoro
characters.line: Three-sword swordsman and Luffy's first crewmate, formerly the bounty hunter known as the Pirate Hunter.

characters.name: Nami
characters.line: Thief and navigator riding with Luffy for her stolen Grand Line map, still openly distrustful of pirates.

characters.name: Coby
characters.line: Luffy's first friend, now a Marine cadet who has sworn to meet Luffy one day across the badge.

characters.name: Shanks
characters.line: Red-Haired pirate captain who took Luffy in as a child, lost his arm to a sea monster saving him, and loaned him the straw hat.

characters.name: Buggy the Clown
characters.line: Chop-Chop Fruit pirate captain and Shanks' old apprentice-mate, sent flying out of town by Luffy but still alive.

beats.label: S2 · Into the Grand Line
beats.text: The Straw Hats descend Reverse Mountain into the Grand Line and are swallowed by Laboon, a whale who has waited fifty years for the pirates who left him behind.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The crew is finally inside the Grand Line — the entire rest of the series unfolds on the other side of this door.

beats.label: S2 · Log pose set
beats.text: Its caretaker Crocus explains that ordinary compasses are useless here — each island must be recorded with a log pose. He gives them one aimed at Whiskey Peak.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes how the Grand Line is navigated at all, and points them at the island where the season's real plot begins.

beats.label: S2 · Whiskey Peak trap
beats.text: Whiskey Peak throws them a welcome, but the townspeople are bounty hunters of a secret organisation, Baroque Works. Zoro, having faked sleep, cuts through a hundred alone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First contact with Baroque Works, the antagonist network driving the rest of the arc.

beats.label: S2 · Vivi's true name
beats.text: Two town agents are exposed as traitors: Igaram of Alabasta's royal guard, and Miss Wednesday, in truth Princess Nefertari Vivi. Assassins are sent to silence them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Vivi's real identity flips her from passenger to the reason for the entire next stretch of the journey.

beats.label: S2 · Crocodile revealed
beats.text: Vivi tells the crew that Baroque Works is stoking rebellion at home, and its hidden leader is the Warlord Sir Crocodile. Spies photograph the meeting, marking them for death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the villain and puts the crew on his kill list — the stakes and the enemy for the rest of the arc, in one scene.

beats.label: S2 · Miss All-Sunday's gift
beats.text: Igaram's decoy ship is blown apart at sea. Crocodile's partner Miss All-Sunday offers them a shortcut to Alabasta, but Luffy destroys it and they turn toward Little Garden.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Crocodile's second-in-command, whose interest in the crew is unexplained but clearly not straightforward.

beats.label: S2 · Coby under Garp
beats.text: Marine recruits Coby and Helmeppo train ragged under Vice-Admiral Garp. He discovers they know Luffy but keeps it quiet, letting them stay under his wing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anchors the Marine-side subplot and plants Garp as a senior figure watching Luffy from a distance.

cliffhanger.text: The crew is escorting Princess Vivi home to stop a Warlord-backed rebellion, with Baroque Works now hunting them by name. The log pose points at Little Garden, not Alabasta.
questions: How does a rookie crew get past a Warlord of the Sea to reach Alabasta?
What is Miss All-Sunday's real angle in tracking them?
Will Coby's tie to Luffy stay hidden as he rises through the Marines?

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.line: Straw Hat captain leading his crew through the Grand Line, now committed to seeing Princess Vivi home.

characters.name: Roronoa Zoro
characters.line: Swordsman and Luffy's blade, who single-handedly cut down a hundred Baroque Works bounty hunters at Whiskey Peak.

characters.name: Nami
characters.line: Navigator steering by log pose through the Grand Line, materially invested in the ship and the crew.

characters.name: Nefertari Vivi
characters.line: Alabasta's crown princess, formerly the Baroque Works agent Miss Wednesday, now riding with the crew to stop a rebellion in her kingdom.

characters.name: Sir Crocodile
characters.line: One of the Seven Warlords of the Sea and the hidden Mr. 0 of Baroque Works, engineering the coup in Alabasta from the shadows.

characters.name: Miss All-Sunday
characters.line: Crocodile's mysterious partner, who found Vivi aboard the Merry and offered the crew a shortcut Luffy refused.

characters.name: Igaram
characters.line: Captain of Alabasta's royal guard who posed as Baroque Works' Mr. 8; his decoy ship was blown apart at sea and his fate is unknown.

characters.name: Coby
characters.line: Marine trainee under Vice-Admiral Garp, driving himself night and day toward officer rank.

characters.name: Vice-Admiral Garp
characters.line: Senior Marine mentoring Coby and Helmeppo, aware they know Luffy but choosing to keep it quiet.
